title: I Made Chess a PVP Game
author: No_Development_3295
selftext:
I always wanted to make a game similar to this, and thanks to AI I did it with 1 prompt in 25 minutes. Crazy. Zero game knowledge, just used an app that builds games. 

No self promo, not putting it out to the public. 

It’s basically a Godot version of chess combined with a PVP aspect. I like to call it Chess Mortal Kombat lol.

Anyways, this is a crazy new world we live in. Excited to keep making games
